full_judgment: 3. Defendant No. 1 entered appearance in the suit and an 16.09.2008 filed an application before the Joint District Judge, First Court, Rangpur under Order VII, Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure (the Code)for rejection of the plaint stating, inter alia, that the plaintiff has instituted the suit for specific performance of contract on the basis of an unregistered bainapatra which is not maintainable as per provision of section 17A of the Registration (Amendment) Act, 2004 (the Act, 2004) and section 21A of the Specific Relief (Amendment) Act and the suit is also barred by limitation.
